import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.1,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.5))
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 10.5)
ax.set_ylim(-0.3, 3.8)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# --- Color palette ---
c_gray = '#B0B0B0'
c_gray_fill = '#E8E8E8'
c_green = '#4CAF50'
c_green_fill = '#E8F5E9'
c_easy = '#80DEEA'       # cyan for easy path
c_easy_fill = '#E0F7FA'
c_blue = '#1976D2'
c_blue_fill = '#BBDEFB'
c_hard_line = '#E65100'  # orange for hard path arrows
c_easy_line = '#00838F'  # teal for easy path arrows
c_exec = '#F5F5F5'
c_exec_edge = '#424242'

def rounded_box(ax, x, y, w, h, label, facecolor, edgecolor, fontsize=10, fontweight='normal', sublabel=None, sublabel_size=7.5):
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x - w/2, y - h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.08", linewidth=1.5,
                         edgecolor=edgecolor, facecolor=facecolor,
                         zorder=3, transform=ax.transData)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(x, y + 0.12, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fontweight, zorder=4)
        ax.text(x, y - 0.18, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=sublabel_size,
                color='#555555', style='italic', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fontweight, zorder=4)
    return box

def diamond(ax, x, y, size, label, facecolor, edgecolor, fontsize=9):
    s = size
    verts = np.array([[x, y+s], [x+s*1.3, y], [x, y-s], [x-s*1.3, y], [x, y+s]])
    poly = mpatches.Polygon(verts, closed=True, facecolor=facecolor, edgecolor=edgecolor,
                            linewidth=1.8, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(poly)
    ax.text(x, y, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
            fontweight='bold', zorder=4)

def arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color='#333333', lw=1.5, style='->', linestyle='-'):
    arr = FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2),
                          arrowstyle=style, mutation_scale=14,
                          linewidth=lw, color=color, linestyle=linestyle,
                          zorder=2, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0,
                          connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0')
    ax.add_patch(arr)

def curved_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color='#333333', lw=1.5, rad=0.3, style='->'):
    arr = FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2),
                          arrowstyle=style, mutation_scale=14,
                          linewidth=lw, color=color,
                          zorder=2, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0,
                          connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}')
    ax.add_patch(arr)

# ==================== NODES ====================

# Row positions
y_main = 1.8    # main row
y_easy = 0.5    # easy path row
y_hard = 3.1    # hard path row

# --- Observation ---
obs_x = 0.3
ax.text(obs_x, y_main, r'$o_t$', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=14,
        fontweight='bold', zorder=4,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FFF9C4', edgecolor='#F9A825', linewidth=1.5))

# --- Frozen VLA ---
vla_x = 2.0
rounded_box(ax, vla_x, y_main, 1.6, 0.85, 'Frozen VLA', c_gray_fill, c_gray,
            fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', sublabel='SmolVLA (450M)', sublabel_size=8)

# --- K=2 samples ---
k2_x = 3.9
rounded_box(ax, k2_x, y_main, 1.1, 0.65, r'$K\!=\!2$ samples', '#FFF3E0', '#FF9800', fontsize=9.5)

# --- Compute d2 ---
d2_x = 5.5
rounded_box(ax, d2_x, y_main, 1.1, 0.65, r'Compute $d_2$', '#F3E5F5', '#9C27B0', fontsize=9.5)

# --- Decision diamond ---
dec_x = 7.1
diamond(ax, dec_x, y_main, 0.45, r'$d_2\!>\!\hat{\tau}$?', c_green_fill, c_green, fontsize=8.5)

# --- Easy path: K=2 mean ---
easy_x = 7.1
rounded_box(ax, easy_x, y_easy, 1.2, 0.6, r'$K\!=\!2$ mean', c_easy_fill, c_easy_line,
            fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# --- Hard path: Extend to K=10 ---
ext_x = 7.1
rounded_box(ax, ext_x, y_hard, 1.2, 0.55, r'Extend $K\!=\!10$', '#FBE9E7', c_hard_line, fontsize=9.5)

# --- Hard path: Argmin Select ---
sel_x = 8.6
rounded_box(ax, sel_x, y_hard, 1.1, 0.55, 'Argmin Select', '#FBE9E7', c_hard_line, fontsize=9.5)

# --- Hard path: CRM Correction ---
crm_x = 8.6
rounded_box(ax, crm_x, y_main, 1.3, 0.75, 'CRM Correct', c_blue_fill, c_blue,
            fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', sublabel='~327K params', sublabel_size=8)

# --- Execute action ---
exec_x = 9.8
rounded_box(ax, exec_x, y_easy, 1.1, 0.6, 'Execute', c_exec, c_exec_edge,
            fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# ==================== ARROWS ====================

# obs -> VLA
arrow(ax, obs_x + 0.35, y_main, vla_x - 0.8, y_main, color='#333')

# VLA -> K=2
arrow(ax, vla_x + 0.8, y_main, k2_x - 0.55, y_main, color='#333')

# K=2 -> Compute d2
arrow(ax, k2_x + 0.55, y_main, d2_x - 0.55, y_main, color='#333')

# Compute d2 -> Decision
arrow(ax, d2_x + 0.55, y_main, dec_x - 0.6, y_main, color='#333')

# Decision -> Easy (No, down)
arrow(ax, dec_x, y_main - 0.45, easy_x, y_easy + 0.3, color=c_easy_line, lw=2.0)
ax.text(dec_x - 0.45, y_main - 0.65, 'No', fontsize=9, color=c_easy_line, fontweight='bold', ha='center')

# Decision -> Hard (Yes, up)
arrow(ax, dec_x, y_main + 0.45, ext_x, y_hard - 0.28, color=c_hard_line, lw=2.0)
ax.text(dec_x - 0.5, y_main + 0.65, 'Yes', fontsize=9, color=c_hard_line, fontweight='bold', ha='center')

# Extend -> Argmin
arrow(ax, ext_x + 0.6, y_hard, sel_x - 0.55, y_hard, color=c_hard_line, lw=2.0)

# Argmin -> CRM
arrow(ax, sel_x, y_hard - 0.28, crm_x, y_main + 0.38, color=c_hard_line, lw=2.0)

# CRM -> Execute (curve down to execute)
curved_arrow(ax, crm_x + 0.65, y_main - 0.1, exec_x, y_easy + 0.3, color=c_hard_line, lw=2.0, rad=-0.3)

# Easy -> Execute
arrow(ax, easy_x + 0.6, y_easy, exec_x - 0.55, y_easy, color=c_easy_line, lw=2.0)

# ==================== PATH LABELS ====================

# Easy path label
ax.text(7.1, y_easy - 0.5, 'easy step', fontsize=8.5, ha='center', va='center',
        color=c_easy_line, fontweight='bold', style='italic')
ax.text(7.1, y_easy - 0.72, '~170 ms', fontsize=7.5, ha='center', va='center',
        color=c_easy_line)

# Hard path label
ax.text(7.85, y_hard + 0.38, 'hard step', fontsize=8.5, ha='center', va='center',
        color=c_hard_line, fontweight='bold', style='italic')
ax.text(7.85, y_hard + 0.58, '~200 ms', fontsize=7.5, ha='center', va='center',
        color=c_hard_line)

# ==================== SAVE ====================
out_path = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_8/projects/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/docs/paper/figures/fig1_pipeline.pdf'
fig.savefig(out_path, format='pdf')
fig.savefig(out_path.replace('.pdf', '.png'), format='png')
print(f'Saved to {out_path}')
print(f'Also saved PNG for preview')
